<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.VersionPayloadXmlComparator</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>This is used by the Post Upgrade Analyses AI Agent</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>VersionPayloadXmlComparator</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var VersionPayloadXmlComparator = Class.create();
VersionPayloadXmlComparator.prototype = {
        initialize: function() {},

        /**
         * Compare the payload XML from two sys_update_version records.
         *
         * @param {String} oldVersionSysId - sys_id of the older version record
         * @param {String} newVersionSysId - sys_id of the newer/current version record
         * @returns {Object} Comparison result
         */
        compare: function(newVersionSysId) {
            //this._validateSysId(oldVersionSysId, 'oldVersionSysId');
            this._validateSysId(newVersionSysId, 'newVersionSysId');

            var newVersion = this._getVersion(newVersionSysId);
			var oldVersion = this._getOldVersion(newVersionSysId);

			if(oldVersion == "not found")
				return "No old version found";

			var oldVersionSysId = oldVersion.sys_id.toString();
            var oldXml = oldVersion.getValue('payload') || '';
            var newXml = newVersion.getValue('payload') || '';

            this._validateXml(oldXml, oldVersionSysId);
            this._validateXml(newXml, newVersionSysId);

            var oldValues = this._flattenXml(oldXml);
            var newValues = this._flattenXml(newXml);

            var result = {
                old_version: {
                    sys_id: oldVersionSysId,
                    record_name: oldVersion.getDisplayValue('file_name'),
                    state: oldVersion.resolution_status.getDisplayValue(),
					disposition: oldVersion.diposition.getDisplayValue(),
                    updated_on: oldVersion.getValue('sys_updated_on')
                },
                new_version: {
                    sys_id: newVersionSysId,
                    record_name: newVersion.getDisplayValue('file_name'),
                    state: newVersion.resolution_status.getDisplayValue(),
					disposition: newVersion.diposition.getDisplayValue(),
                    updated_on: newVersion.getValue('sys_updated_on')
                },
                summary: {
                    added: 0,
                    removed: 0,
                    modified: 0,
                    unchanged: 0,
                    total_differences: 0
                },
                differences: []
            };

            var path;
            var seen = {};

            // Nodes/attributes removed or modified
            for (path in oldValues) {
                if (!oldValues.hasOwnProperty(path)) {
                    continue;
                }

                seen[path] = true;

                if (!newValues.hasOwnProperty(path)) {
                    result.differences.push({
                        type: 'removed',
                        path: path,
                        old_value: oldValues[path],
                        new_value: null
                    });
                    result.summary.removed++;
                } else if (oldValues[path] !== newValues[path]) {
                    result.differences.push({
                        type: 'modified',
                        path: path,
                        old_value: oldValues[path],
                        new_value: newValues[path]
                    });
                    result.summary.modified++;
                } else {
                    result.summary.unchanged++;
                }
            }

            // Nodes/attributes added
            for (path in newValues) {
                if (!newValues.hasOwnProperty(path) || seen[path]) {
                    continue;
                }

                result.differences.push({
                    type: 'added',
                    path: path,
                    old_value: null,
                    new_value: newValues[path]
                });
                result.summary.added++;
            }

            result.summary.total_differences =
                result.summary.added +
                result.summary.removed +
                result.summary.modified;

            return result;
        },

        /**
         * Gets a sys_update_version record.
         */
        _getVersion: function(sysId) {
            var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_upgrade_history_log');
            if (!gr.get(sysId)) {
                throw new Error('Version record not found: ' + sysId);
            }

            if (!gr.canRead()) {
                throw new Error('Not authorized to read version record: ' + sysId);
            }

            return gr;
        },

        _getOldVersion: function(currentVersion) {
                var skp = new GlideRecord('sys_upgrade_history_log');
                if (skp.get(currentVersion.toString())) {
                    var getPrevSkp = new GlideRecord('sys_upgrade_history_log');
                    getPrevSkp.addQuery("disposition", "4");
                    getPrevSkp.addQuery("changed", "true");
                    getPrevSkp.addQuery("file_name", skp.getValue('file_name'));
                    getPrevSkp.addQuery("sys_created_on", "<", skp.sys_created_on);
                    getPrevSkp.orderByDesc("sys_created_on");
                    getPrevSkp.query();
                    if (getPrevSkp.next()) {
							return getPrevSkp;
                    }
					else
						return "not found";
				}
		},

                    /**
                     * Validates XML prior to parsing.
                     */
                    _validateXml: function(xml, versionSysId) {
                            if (!xml) {
                                throw new Error('Payload is empty for version record: ' + versionSysId);
                            }

                            xml = GlideXMLUtil.removeInvalidChars(xml);

                            var validationError = GlideXMLUtil.validateXML(xml, false, false);
                            if (validationError) {
                                throw new Error(
                                    'Invalid XML payload for version record ' +
                                    versionSysId +
                                    ': ' +
                                    validationError
                                );
                            }
                        },

                        /**
                         * Converts XML into a path/value map for comparison.
                         *
                         * Examples:
                         * /sys_script/name = "My Business Rule"
                         * /sys_script/active = "true"
                         * /sys_script/script = "..."
                         * /sys_script@action_insert = "true"
                         */
                        _flattenXml: function(xml) {
                            var document = new XMLDocument2();
                            document.parseXML(GlideXMLUtil.removeInvalidChars(xml));

                            var root = document.getDocumentElement();
                            var values = {};

                            this._walkNode(root, '/' + root.getNodeName(), values);

                            return values;
                        },

                        /**
                         * Recursively walks XML elements and collects values and attributes.
                         * Element indexes make repeated nodes distinguishable.
                         */
                        _walkNode: function(node, path, values) {
                            var attributes = node.getAttributes();
                            var attributeName;

                            // Add attributes
                            for (attributeName in attributes) {
                                if (attributes.hasOwnProperty(attributeName)) {
                                    values[path + '/@' + attributeName] = String(attributes[attributeName]);
                                }
                            }

                            var iterator = node.getChildNodeIterator();
                            var children = [];
                            var nameCounts = {};
                            var child;

                            // Ignore whitespace-only #text nodes introduced by formatted XML.
                            while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                                child = iterator.next();

                                if (child.getNodeName() === '#text') {
                                    var text = String(child.getNodeValue() || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
                                    if (text) {
                                        values[path] = text;
                                    }
                                    continue;
                                }

                                children.push(child);
                                nameCounts[child.getNodeName()] = (nameCounts[child.getNodeName()] || 0) + 1;
                            }

                            // Add children. Index only repeated sibling element names.
                            var nameIndexes = {};
                            for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                                child = children[i];

                                var childName = child.getNodeName();
                                nameIndexes[childName] = (nameIndexes[childName] || 0) + 1;

                                var childPath = path + '/' + childName;
                                if (nameCounts[childName] > 1) {
                                    childPath += '[' + nameIndexes[childName] + ']';
                                }

                                this._walkNode(child, childPath, values);
                            }
                        },

                        _validateSysId: function(sysId, parameterName) {
                            if (!sysId || !/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/i.test(String(sysId))) {
                                throw new Error(parameterName + ' must be a valid 32-character sys_id.');
                            }
                        },

                        type: 'VersionPayloadXmlComparator'
                };]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>sharath.vasishta@snc</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-14 06:00:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>a3482fbdc31b0f1040829a4bb0013183</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>VersionPayloadXmlComparator</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_a3482fbdc31b0f1040829a4bb0013183</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>sharath.vasishta@snc</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-16 05:39:40</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
